The multilingual evidence is uniform — English 'Abidan,' Spanish 'Abidan,' French 'Abidan,' German 'Abidan' — reflecting straightforward transliteration of a single referent."

All five occurrences appear in Numbers in official registers: the census (Num 1:11), camp positioning (Num 2:22), and tabernacle dedication offerings (Num 7:60, 65; 10:24).
